# Sample planning note — mid-band radio context

Source-id: sample-mid-band-context
Locator: section-2

Mid-band cells (for example n78 or n41) typically balance capacity and coverage. High BLER on mid-band is often associated with:

- Indoor penetration loss at the cell edge
- Inter-cell interference from a dense mid-band layer
- Mismatched UE capability or band combination
- Backhaul or scheduler saturation that shows up as radio errors

Use synthetic or measured KPI context (BLER, drop rate, latency, band) only as prompt context. This note does not authorise network writes.
